item.title: Facebook officially rolls out its standalone Creator Studio app with AI tools for creators
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The new app launches with Facebook's AI creator assistant built into it, providing creators with personalized recommendations based on their content style, performance, audience engagement, and goals.

item.title: How a $250 million acquisition collapsed into allegations of fraud and forged signatures
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Investors are still waiting for their share of the $250 million windfall, and VideoVerse co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav is now at the center of multiple legal cases.

item.title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: This is the latest zero-day released by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, despite Microsoft publicly threatening to take legal action against them.

item.title: Silkroad Innovation Hub’s Road to Battlefield competition continues
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: The Road to Battlefield competition is now in its second year, and its purpose is to give founders across Central Eurasia a direct route to Startup Battlefield

item.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: From the Pixel 11 series and a brand new competitor to Apple’s AirTag, here are all the announcements from the Made by Google 2026 event.

item.title: Google’s Quick Share adds a tap-to-share mode
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Google's Quick Share feature is getting a tap-to-share mode for quickly exchanging contacts, photos, videos, and more.

item.title: Google’s Pixel 11 lineup offers fewer hardware changes, but much more Gemini
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The Google Pixel 11 series starts $100 costlier than the last year, but offers 256GB base storage.

item.title: Google unveils the Pixel Watch 5 with a smarter Gemini and advanced health monitoring
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The new smartwatch, which starts at $399, can track blood pressure patterns and insulin resistance, as well as deliver personalized help and better sleep tracking.

item.title: Google takes on AirTag with the new $29 Pixel Tag
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Google’s new Pixel Tag taps into its Find Hub network to help users track lost keys, bags, and other items.

item.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 Pro Fold offers a stronger build and brighter screens
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold will cost $1,899.

item.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith’s valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Blacksmith says revenue has grown more than tenfold over the past year.

item.title: Reservoir raises $8M to make water heaters that people — and the grid — will actually want
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Reservoir has built an ultra-efficient water heater that can predict hot water demand, store energy, and detect plumbing leaks throughout a home.

item.title: India’s Yulu raises $93M as quick-commerce boom fuels e-bike demand
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Yulu aims to have a fleet of 200,000 bikes in the next two years and faster electric two-wheelers, aiming at new logistics use cases.

item.title: Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni reportedly knew Phia was ‘cookie stuffing’ for months
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Phia, the shopping startup co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, is once again under fire for its alleged business practices.

item.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.

item.title: Uber surprised robotics company Serve by selling its entire stake
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The divestiture comes as the two once-tight companies have started to diverge on the business side.

item.title: FBI says cybercriminals are hacking into victims’ online accounts to steal their intimate pictures
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: In a new alert, the FBI said cybercriminals are targeting adults and minors in an attempt to steal their personal and intimate pictures in extortion campaigns.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

item.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google.

item.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.
